Left edge shows parts of a facing page (partial text in the left margin, not transcribed as it is the edge of the neighbouring page).

main_text.p: quisitioni aurem accommodabit, dum quid sibi Helias velit, perpenderit, ut metallorum transformationem rectius intelligat.

Constat inter eos, quorum sententia chymiæ adversaria est, nullos magis obniti, quàm Physicos & Theologos. Utriq; quæ ex principijs & fontibus naturæ hauriunt, quibus efficere conantur transformationem metallicam partim ἀδύνατον esse, partim ordini creationis adversari, in progressu tractationis hujus disputabimus. Quæ autem merè Theologica sunt, & cum principijs Physicis parum aut nihil commune habent, ea paucis nunc præfando quasi delibabimus. Sunt autem ferè duûm generum ab Exemplo & usu. Exempla singularium & universorum.

page.notes: The Greek word "ἀδύνατον" is printed in a larger italic-style Greek face; transcribed as best read. The word "partim" is followed by a Greek word in the scan that is partly illegible. Left margin shows fragments of the facing page, not transcribed.
